headline: Board to consider FY27 capital improvement bonds and public improvement infrastructure bonds under the March 4, 2025 voter authorization.
summary: The board will consider a resolution on Northern Border Regional Commission Authorized Officials for the Department of Finance and Administration, and a resolution authorizing capital improvement bonds for Fiscal Year 2027 and public improvement infrastructure bonds under the March 4, 2025 voter authorization.
items: Approve resolution authorizing the Director of Public Works to execute grant agreements with the Northern Border Regional Commission (NBRC), make budget amendments, and take related actions, subject to City Attorney review
Approve and recommend that City Council adopt the resolution on Authorization For Capital Improvement Bonds For Fiscal Year 2027 And Public Improvement Infrastructure Bonds, related to FY27 borrowing
location: Bushor Conference Room, 149 Church Street, 1st Floor
